name: comp_drum_bus_minimal
description: Drum bus glue — barely-there (preserves LRA aggressively for spacious mixes)
notes: 1.5:1 ratio with high threshold -12 dB and slow 30 ms attack. Target: < 0.5 dB GR, basically transparent. Use when the master phase needs full dynamic range to work cleanly (e.g. when industry premaster spec LRA ≥ 6 LU is the target). Trade-off: less bus-glue character — the kit feels like separate pieces rather than one fused sound. For prog-metal where each kit piece needs space, this is the right move.
